layout.body:
SAVE 20%
It's only a phone
call away
MAYCOTT HOTELS
Over 30 five-star hotels all over the nation to suit your every need
Reserve a room today, and you will save 20% on all rooms at Maycott “Room for the Day”(excluding tax) by using your American Express Corporate Card.
Due to seasonal demands, the availability of rooms may be subject to each hotel's situation. An advanced reservation, to be made by calling our toll free number 1-800-755-0090 at least 10 working days before your stay, is required to qualify for the discount.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a condition placed on receiving the discount?

options.A: A guest can use any type of credit card to pay for a room.
options.B: The booking must be done well in advance of checking into the hotel
options.C: The reservations must be carried out by phone and website.
options.D: Guests must make their payments in cash

questions.analysis: Which of the following is a condition placed on receiving the discount? 原文依据：An advanced reservation… at least 10 working days before your stay, is required to qualify for the discount. 享受折扣的条件是至少提前 10 个工作日预订，也就是必须提前预订。 A：可用任何信用卡 → 错误，必须用美国运通公司卡 B：必须在入住前提前预订 → 正确 C：必须电话和网站都预订 → 错误，只说打电话 D：必须现金支付 → 错误

questions.stem: What will the discount apply to?
questions.analysis: What will the discount apply to? 原文依据：save 20% on all rooms… “Room for the Day” 折扣适用于房间（住宿）。 A：住宿 → 正确 B：餐食 → 未提 C：交通 → 未提 D：销售税 → 明确排除

questions.stem: What can be implied from the advertisement?

options.A: Most travelers don't make a habit of making reservations prior to checking in.
options.B: There is a business relationship between the credit card company and the hotel.
options.C: The hotel gets very busy during the summer season.
options.D: It usually takes a minimum of 10 days for a credit card to clear

questions.analysis: What can be implied from the advertisement? 原文依据：using your American Express Corporate Card 酒店指定使用某家信用卡才能打折，说明酒店和信用卡公司有商业合作关系。 A：大多数旅客不习惯提前预订 → 无法推断 B：信用卡公司和酒店有商业关系 → 正确 C：酒店夏季很忙 → 只说季节性需求，没特指夏天 D：信用卡结账至少要 10 天 → 错误
